name: Quantum Open Source Foundation
description: The Quantum Open Source Foundation (QOSF) is a community organization dedicated to supporting the development and growth of open-source quantum software. QOSF runs mentorship programs, organizes events, and maintains a curated list of quantum computing projects. It aims to lower barriers to entry and foster collaboration in the quantum computing ecosystem.

news.title: Quantum Open Source Foundation Kicks Off the Wittek Quantum Prize
news.excerpt: The Quantum Open Source Foundation and Unitary Fund launched a $4,000 prize dedicated to celebrating open source software contributors in the quantum computing space
